title: Bobby the drummer, Black Benny and the break-up of Vincent's band
summary: Vincent says drummer Bobby played with Chris Kelly and then with his band, followed by Black Benny. After Maurice Durant returned from the war and tried to boss the band, it broke up, and he recalls the players joking about age.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
